objective: Enforce least privilege and deny unauthorized access
requirement: Application role and resource authorization contract must be supplied before execution
evidence: JUnit result, sanitized trace, redacted API response

requirement: Every executed test has an ID, timestamp, environment, result, and safe artifact reference
evidence: JUnit/XML, HTML report, sanitized traces and screenshots

objective: Protect authentication secrets and session material
requirement: No credentials, tokens, cookies, or production PII in repository or artifacts
automation: Redaction tests and secret scanning in CI
evidence: Scan result and redaction test result

objective: Identify vulnerable dependencies and supply-chain risks
requirement: Pinned dependencies and vulnerability scanning are required for changes
automation: npm audit and approved SAST/SCA tools in CI

objective: Ensure API responses enforce approved transport and browser security policy
requirement: Approved API security headers must be present on the configured response
evidence: Status, approved header assertions, and sanitized Playwright result

requirement: Protected API resources reject requests without authentication
evidence: Safe response status and sanitized Playwright result

objective: Enforce least privilege at API boundaries
requirement: A configured forbidden role cannot access the protected resource
evidence: Safe response status and sanitized Playwright result

requirement: Approved malformed input returns the contract validation status without a server error
evidence: Safe response status and sanitized Playwright result

objective: Limit API operations to the approved method contract
requirement: An unsupported HTTP method is rejected with the approved status
evidence: Safe response status and sanitized Playwright result

objective: Preserve required API audit event fields
requirement: The approved audit response contains the required attributable event fields
evidence: Required-field assertions and sanitized Playwright result

objective: Maintain clear assessment and authorization boundaries
requirement: Automation evidence does not establish FedRAMP certification or agency ATO
evidence: Signed review record and control matrix

objective: Preserve access to the mission-critical application for approved users
requirement: Approved synthetic user can complete the application authentication workflow
evidence: Sanitized Playwright result, trace on failure, and screenshot on failure

objective: Verify the primary mission-critical user journey
requirement: Application owner supplies the approved journey path and synthetic completion marker
evidence: Sanitized Playwright result, trace on failure, and screenshot on failure

objective: Protect completion of the critical business transaction
requirement: Approved synthetic transaction reaches its documented confirmation state
evidence: Sanitized Playwright result, trace on failure, and screenshot on failure

objective: Prevent unauthorized access within the mission-critical workflow
requirement: Application owner supplies approved role boundary and expected authorized marker
evidence: Role-aware result, redacted response, and trace on failure

objective: Maintain session completion and auditability of the critical workflow
requirement: Application exposes an approved completion/audit confirmation marker
evidence: Safe audit confirmation, timestamps, and sanitized trace
